# Joint_Kinematics

[Project home](../../../README.md) · [Folder guide](../../../Documentation/project_structure.md)

Joint_Kinematics

Computed intact-cat forward results. The columns and named arrays below describe the simulated quantities. [Simulation results](../simulation_report.md).

- [acceleration_from_saved_velocities.csv](acceleration_from_saved_velocities.csv) — Accelerations estimated by differentiating the saved velocities; these are not the internal integration-step accelerations.
- [anatomical_joint_angles_deg.csv](anatomical_joint_angles_deg.csv) — Predicted angles between adjacent anatomical segments, in degrees, using the same convention as the comparison figures.
- [generalized_positions.csv](generalized_positions.csv) — Predicted model coordinates: metres for translations and radians for rotations. These coordinates are not all anatomical joint angles.
- [generalized_velocities.csv](generalized_velocities.csv) — Predicted coordinate velocities: m/s for translations and rad/s for rotations.
